# Sleep Calculator

> Free sleep calculator based on 90-minute sleep cycles, plus in-depth guides on sleep science, hygiene, and healthy routines.

Sleep Calculator helps you find the ideal bedtime or wake-up time so you wake up at the end of a natural sleep cycle instead of in the middle of one. The site also publishes plain-English articles covering the four sleep stages, sleep debt, napping, shift work, and how diet, exercise, light, and screens affect your rest.

## Pages

- [Home — Sleep Calculator](/): Calculate bedtime or wake-up time based on 90-minute sleep cycles.
- [Tools](/tools): Additional sleep tools including nap calculator, chronotype quiz, and caffeine cutoff.
- [Blog](/blog): Guides on sleep science, sleep hygiene, and healthy routines.
- [About](/about): What Sleep Calculator is and who it's for.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the Sleep Calculator team.

- [Best Sleep Schedule for Night Shift Workers](/blog/3): Protecting health when work hours fight your body clock.
- [How Blue Light Affects Your Sleep](/blog/4): What screens do to melatonin and small changes that help.
- [Power Napping: A Complete Guide](/blog/6): How long to nap, when to nap, and how to avoid grogginess.
- [Sleep Debt: Can You Really Catch Up?](/blog/7): What sleep debt is and whether weekends can fix it.
- [REM Sleep vs Deep Sleep](/blog/8): What each stage does for your body and mind.
- [The Role of Melatonin in Sleep](/blog/10): When melatonin supplements help and when they don't.
- [The Sleep Hygiene Checklist](/blog/19): The habits sleep specialists recommend to almost every patient.
